# React Bits / ShapeGrid

Official React Bits component, vendored on 2026-10-31 with its accompanying license (see LICENSE.md).

- JSX source: https://github.com/DavidHDev/react-bits/blob/main/src/content/Backgrounds/ShapeGrid/ShapeGrid.jsx
- CSS source: https://github.com/DavidHDev/react-bits/blob/main/src/content/Backgrounds/ShapeGrid/ShapeGrid.css
- Project: https://github.com/DavidHDev/react-bits

The application uses the square shape with 16px cells, slow diagonal motion, theme-aware notebook colors and reduced-motion support through src/NotebookGrid.jsx. The Next.js directive was removed for Vite, and an explicit React import was added for the JSX configuration. An optional interactive flag was added so the notebook background can fully disable hover and click effects.
